# infoblox_forward_looking_delegation (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox ForwardLookingDelegation in the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Create a Federated Realm (required as a parent)
resource "infoblox_federated_realm" "example" {
  uddi = {
    name = "example_federated_realm"
  }
}

// Create a Forward Looking Delegation with basic fields
resource "infoblox_forward_looking_delegation" "example" {
  uddi = {
    address          = "10.10.0.0"
    cidr             = 24
    federated_realms = [infoblox_federated_realm.example.id]
  }
}

// Create a Forward Looking Delegation with additional fields
resource "infoblox_forward_looking_delegation" "example_with_additional_fields" {
  uddi = {
    address          = "10.20.0.0"
    cidr             = 24
    federated_realms = [infoblox_federated_realm.example.id]

    # Other optional fields
    name    = "example_forward_looking_delegation"
    comment = "Example Forward Looking Delegation created through Terraform"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// Create an IPv6 Forward Looking Delegation
resource "infoblox_forward_looking_delegation" "example_ipv6" {
  uddi = {
    address          = "2001:db8:a1::"
    cidr             = 48
    federated_realms = [infoblox_federated_realm.example.id]
    name             = "example_forward_looking_delegation_ipv6"
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))
- `update_trigger` (String) An arbitrary value used to trigger an update. Not sent to the API. Change it when Terraform reports no infrastructure changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Required:

- `address` (String) The address field in form “a.b.c.d/n” where the “/n” may be omitted. In this case, the CIDR value must be defined in the _cidr_ field. When reading, the _address_ field is always in the form “a.b.c.d”.
- `federated_realms` (List of String) The resource identifier.

Optional:

- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the delegation. This is required, if _address_ does not specify it in its input.
- `comment` (String) The description for the delegation. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `federated_pool_id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the delegation. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the delegation in JSON format.

Read-Only:

- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
